title: Registry Acceptance Policy Profile Reference
description: Exact reference to a reusable acceptance profile embedded in a version-pinned shared policy-registry entry. Sellers add separate local profiles to narrow it; they do not copy and mutate a registry profile under the same identity.

x-adcp-validation.resolver_integrity: Resolve the exact policy_id/policy_version. The resolver returns canonical_content and content_digest; RFC 8785-canonicalize canonical_content, verify that its SHA-256 equals both content_digest and policy_digest, then select the embedded profile_id/profile_version and verify profile_digest before use. A null digest or canonical_content is not sufficient for a pinned registry profile.
